question: The value of 2 × 7 ÷ 14 of 4 – 5 ÷ 4 × (9 – 11) + 2 – 2 × 6 ÷ 8 of 3, is:
solution:

Calculation:

2 × 7 ÷ 14 of 4 – 5 ÷ 4 × (9 – 11) + 2 – 2 × 6 ÷ 8 of 3

⇒ 2 × 7 ÷ 14 of 4 – 5 ÷ 4 × (-2) + 2 – 2 × 6 ÷ 8 of 3

⇒ 2 × 7 ÷ 56 – 5 ÷ 4 × (-2) + 2 – 2 × 6 ÷ 24

⇒ 2 × 1over8 – 5over4 × (-2) + 2 – 2 × 6over24 

⇒ 1over4 + 5over2 + 2 – 1over2 

⇒ 17over4 = 4 (1)/(4)

∴ The answer to the expression is 4 (1)/(4).
